decision.reason: [ev-a7c9af863980] says only that support for Kafka 3.8.0 and 3.8.1 is removed. The kafka-versions.yaml diffs [ev-029b4f635db8][ev-e7a043486f16] confirm that 3.8.0 and 3.8.1 are no longer in the supported rows. Neither says what happens to a cluster still on those versions under 0.46.0, such as failed reconciliation, rejected resources or a blocked upgrade, so the proposed workload-failure claim that "the operator will not function" is not supported. To decide the kind, we need upgrade-guide or documentation text saying how the 0.46.0 operator handles a Kafka resource that sets an unsupported version.
